text:
incident-bot: ALERT: realtime latency regression detected
incident-bot: Metric: endpoint=realtime-generate.prod | p95=420ms -> 1.1s (baseline 380ms) | p99=1.2s -> 2.6s (breach threshold 1.5s) | streaming stalls observed
ash: ack. oncall team, taking initial triage. tagging @oncall-sre
maria: I'm on MLP duty, pulling grafana -> https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/rt/latency?orgId=1&panelId=4
maria: p95 spike originates from us-west-2, tail is larger for long sequences (>1k tokens)
nicole: can you run a quick check on batching? `rbctl metrics query --range 10m --expr='sum(rate(requests_batch_size[5m])) by (pool)'`
nicole: also run `kubectl logs -n inference $(kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=realtime -o name) --tail 200 | grep 'stall'`
raj: running `curl -s -w "%{time_total}" -o /dev/null https://realtime.us-west-2.api.redwood.ai/v1/stream` -> 2.1s (confirming high tail)
dashbot: Alert attached: incident-2154321000 -> severity: P1, notified oncall
devon: checking model variant routing — looks like a mix of fp16-quant and int8-legacy under the same pool. possibility of kernel fallback for some sequences.
ash: can we flip routing to prefer int8-optimized nodes for this pool? what's quick mitigation? @devon
devon: short term: reroute traffic to backup pool `realtime-int8-opt` (no schema change). command:
```
rbctl route update --service realtime-generate --from-pool realtime-main --to-pool realtime-int8-opt --percent 100 --dry-run=false
```
devon: starting rollout now, expect warmup ~30s
maria: enabling degraded streaming mode (reduce chunk size) to lower pressure: `PATCH /v1/config?streaming_chunk=256`
nicole: increased autoscale min from 3 -> 6 for that zone (aws-us-west-2) via infra console, scaling started
raj: tail latency dropping: ran same curl -> 1.0s
ash: p99 now ~1.3s from 2.6s. still above SLO but improving. log shows some ossl kernel WARNs for a few pods
maria: listing affected customers via analytics: top impacted workspace ids: w_koi, w-astro, w-enterprise-12 (approx 0.8% of total requests)
ash: customer-impact: low volume but interactive latency for some sessions (chat UX degrade). Customer success ping queued
devon: note: there's a pending kernel patch rolling; can we coordinate fallback to avoid mixing kernels? qa flagged for tonight
oncall-sre: I will take over the investigation for the next hour. @ash please handoff any remaining tasks. I'll monitor dashboards and contact infra if scaling stalls
ash: handing off — key actions done: reroute completed, degraded streaming enabled, autoscale bumped. follow-up: check for kernel mismatch rollout and confirm no regressions on other regions
oncall-sre: acknowledged. I'll open a tracking incident doc and update postmortem template.
incident-bot: Update: remediation progress logged -> reroute applied, autoscale triggered, degraded mode on. Closing immediate page. Continue monitoring. :white_check_mark:
